results.question: Quel Pokémon peut tirer dix tonnes sans se reposer d'après le Pokédex, et quel est son type ?
sources: SELECT s.name_fr AS pokemon_name, STRING_AGG(t.name_fr, ', ') AS types FROM species AS s JOIN pokemon AS p ON p.species_id = s.id JOIN pokemon_types AS pt ON pt.pokemon_id = p.id JOIN types AS t ON t.id = pt.type_id WHERE s.name = 'mudsdale' AND p.is_default = TRUE GROUP BY s.name_fr LIMIT 200
